headline: FOMC DAY 1 LIVE: FED MEETINGS BEGIN AS GOLD HOLDS $4,083 — WARSH DECISION AND PRESS CONFERENCE TOMORROW AT 2:30 PM ET
snippet: The Federal Open Market Committee convened today (July 28) for the first of its two-day July meeting, with Chair Kevin Warsh's policy statement due at 2:00 p.m. ET and press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET on July 29. Markets are pricing approximately an 80% probability of a hold at 3.50%–3.75%, with a residual 20% probability of a 25-basis-point hike that reflects the committee's 9-to-8 split revealed in June minutes. Gold is trading at approximately $4,083 — down from Monday's $4,110 ceasefire peak — as the market awaits resolution on FOMC day. Kiplinger's live blog is tracking the meeting with real-time updates on the rate decision's implications for gold, equities, and the dollar; July 29 also brings Q2 results from both Kinross Gold and Agnico Eagle after the close.

headline: KITCO SWOT: DUNDEE PRECIOUS METALS AND DISCOVERY SILVER ROSE 10%+ LAST WEEK — GOLD STILL 29% BELOW $5,600 PEAK
snippet: Kitco's weekly Gold SWOT column for July 27 highlights Dundee Precious Metals (TSX: DPM) and Discovery Silver Corp. (TSXV: DSV) as the week's standout performers, both rising more than 10% despite gold trading 29% below its January all-time high of approximately $5,600. The column notes that speculative positioning in gold remains lean relative to historic norms at current price levels — meaning the speculative overhang that caps precious metals rallies has not been rebuilt since the spring correction — a setup that can produce outsized moves when a macro catalyst re-attracts institutional flow. The dual outperformers suggest the market is selectively re-rating names with near-term catalysts or undervalued asset bases, independent of the metal's macro direction.

headline: HAMILTON: SUMMER SELLOFF CREATES CLASSIC AUTUMN ENTRY — BEST SEASONAL SETUP IN YEARS FOR GOLD STOCKS (GOLDSEEK)
snippet: Adam Hamilton's analysis on GoldSeek argues that gold's anomalous summer 2026 selloff — driven by new-Fed-chair hawkishness fears and geopolitical uncertainty around the U.S.-Iran conflict — has produced the seasonal entry point that historically precedes gold stocks' strongest autumn performance window (late June through late September). Hamilton notes he has been rebuilding trading positions in gold stocks in recent weeks, citing GDX's compressed valuation relative to gold and the historical tendency for mining equities to lead gold higher during the seasonal recovery phase. At $4,082 gold with GDX near its floor, Hamilton argues the risk-reward is asymmetrically bullish for the next 60 to 90 days — a contrarian view that directly contradicts retail investors who fled the sector during the ceasefire-driven gold correction.

headline: MKANGO/HYPROMAG OPENS FIRST U.S. NdFeB MAGNET FACILITY IN TEXAS — H1 2027 COMMISSIONING, 400 mt/yr (TSXV: MKA)
snippet: Mkango Resources Ltd. (TSXV: MKA) announced July 27 that HyProMag USA's Ironhead facility in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, will commission cutting and finishing of NdFeB magnet blocks in H1 2027, with blocks supplied from HyProMag's UK and German operations. Full integrated manufacturing — including the HPMS hydrogen decrepitation processing section — follows in Q2 2028, reaching approximately 400 metric tonnes per year of recycled sintered NdFeB magnets plus 278 mt/year of co-products. This will be the first commercial-scale NdFeB magnet finishing capability in the United States, a direct strategic counter to China's rare earth export restrictions that have blocked Western manufacturers from sourcing commercial volumes of neodymium-iron-boron magnets. The facility sits inside the U.S. defence industrial base and is positioned to serve American EV, wind turbine, and defence procurement markets currently without a domestic supply option.

headline: G50 CORP CONFIRMS 1.8KM GOLD-SILVER-GALLIUM ZONE IN ARIZONA — GALLIUM BONUS AS CHINA RESTRICTS EXPORTS (ASX: G50)
snippet: G50 Corp Ltd. (ASX: G50) announced July 27 that Phase 2 metallurgical testing at the Golconda Gold Project in Arizona has confirmed gold, silver, and gallium mineralisation over a 1.8-kilometre strike at the Tub Structural Zone, with low-cost processing capable of concentrating gallium at approximately double the head grade while co-producing gold and silver. Gallium — currently subject to Chinese export controls that have created supply disruption for global semiconductor and defence manufacturers — occurs consistently throughout the hydrothermal alteration halo across parallel quartz-sulphide veins. Phase 2 results show the mineralised system is broader and more continuous than Phase 1 indicated, establishing Golconda as an unusual multi-commodity target in the context of accelerating Western critical mineral supply chain urgency.

headline: FISSION URANIUM'S EX-CEO JOINS SHINE MINERALS — McELROY'S $1.1B PALADIN EXIT SIGNALS NEW URANIUM VEHICLE (TSXV: SMR.H)
snippet: Shine Minerals Corp. (TSXV: SMR.H) appointed Ross McElroy as President, Chief Executive Officer and Director on July 27. McElroy co-founded Fission Uranium and served as CEO until Paladin Energy's $1.14 billion acquisition of Fission closed in December 2024, having played a key role in the discovery and development of the Triple R deposit in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin. His appointment to Shine — currently halted (designated .H on the TSXV) — strongly signals an imminent reorganisation or new uranium project acquisition. McElroy brings nearly four decades of exploration geology experience, a proven track record of world-class uranium discovery, and a deep investor network in the uranium sector at a moment when uranium spot is holding near $86/lb and the market is actively rewarding discovery-stage management teams.

headline: BAYHORSE SILVER HALTS OREGON DRILLING AS 45,000-ACRE WILDFIRE SHUTS 80-MILE STRETCH OF I-84 (TSXV: BHS)
snippet: Bayhorse Silver Inc. (TSXV: BHS) suspended underground drilling at its Bayhorse Silver Mine in eastern Oregon on July 24 after a wildfire at Fox Creek — 7 miles north of the mine — rapidly expanded to more than 45,000 acres by July 25 and forced the closure of Interstate I-84 over an 80-mile stretch through the Huntington area. The Bayhorse Mine sits beside Brownlee Reservoir between Fox Creek and Huntington, providing a natural water barrier, but CEO Graeme O'Neill noted that wildfire behaviour near large bodies of water remains difficult to predict. The 2,000-metre Phase 1 underground diamond drilling program, commenced June 1, was less than two months into its initial phase when the suspension occurred; timeline to resumption depends on fire containment and road access restoration.

headline: NORTHERN LIGHTS DRILLS VIRGIN Cu TARGET NEAR DAWSON CITY — UP TO 3.8% Cu IN SOILS AT PUP PROJECT, YUKON (CSE: NLR)
source_name: Investing News Network / Northern Lights Resources
snippet: Northern Lights Resources Corp. (CSE: NLR) commenced the first-ever drill test at its Pup Copper-Gold Project, 10 kilometres west of Dawson City, Yukon, on July 27. The 10-hole, 600-metre reverse-circulation scout program targets the Petal Zone — an open-ended 1,000-by-400-metre anomaly returning surface rock grabs up to 3.799% copper — and the Gismo Zone, a second copper-molybdenum-gold-silver anomaly. All prior work including soil geochemistry, hand trenching, prospecting, and ground magnetics converged on the same conclusion: a near-surface copper system that has never been drill tested. The fully funded program provides a binary result by year-end — drill-or-walk decision on a target with porphyry characteristics 30 km from existing Yukon infrastructure.

headline: GGL RESOURCES LOCKS UP 4 Cu-Au YUKON PROJECTS FROM STRATEGIC METALS — PORPHYRY TO EPITHERMAL, SW YUKON (TSXV: GGL)
snippet: GGL Resources Corp. (TSXV: GGL) announced July 27 it has optioned four copper-gold properties in southwestern Yukon — Hopper, Kluane, Batt, and Moraine — from related-party Strategic Metals Ltd. (TSXV: SMD), which holds 30.35% of GGL. The four projects span porphyry, skarn, VMS, and epithermal copper-gold styles, all within the SW Yukon infrastructure corridor near roads, power, and port access. Consideration consists of 21 million GGL shares payable over 36 months plus cash, subject to shareholder approval targeted for August 31, 2026. The multi-style, multi-target bundle gives GGL a diversified Yukon Cu-Au land package assembled by Strategic Metals — one of the most active prospect generators on the TSXV.

headline: NEXTSOURCE MOLO PHASE 2 FEASIBILITY: US$402.5M NPV, 21% IRR, 150K tpa GRAPHITE EXPANSION IN MADAGASCAR (TSX: NEXT)
snippet: NextSource Materials Inc. (TSX: NEXT) released an updated feasibility study on July 27 for a Phase 2 expansion of its operating Molo Graphite Mine in Madagascar, returning a pre-tax NPV of US$402.5 million (8% discount rate), a 21.0% pre-tax IRR, and a 37-year mine life at 150,000 tonnes per year of SuperFlake® graphite concentrate. Phase 2 capital is estimated at US$290.8 million, structured across three new 50,000-tonne-per-year modular processing units in two construction phases, designed to reduce execution risk and build time versus conventional mine construction. NextSource has not yet made a production decision for Phase 1 of the expansion and is in active discussions with offtakers and strategic partners on timing; the updated feasibility study provides the bankable technical foundation for those conversations at a moment when graphite supply chains outside China are of acute strategic interest.
